name: satyr
description: a Satyr (Fall from Heaven), a goat-legged forest creature: two curled brown ram horns, pointed ears, a wreath of holly leaves and red berries on his brown hair, a red-brown beard and a sly grin, a bare tanned muscular chest crossed by a green leaf sash, a brown belt with yellow tassels over a green leaf kilt, shaggy brown goat legs with dark hooves, his RIGHT hand on his hip, and a long gnarled wooden crook staff wrapped in green vines held upright in his LEFT hand
hands: the vine-wrapped crook staff stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand is an empty fist on the screen-left side, resting on his hip at rest

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear hoof, torso leans back, the right hand leaves his hip as an empty fist, the vine-wrapped crook staff is lifted up over the head with its curled crook pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched on bent goat legs, the crook staff cocked behind the head with its curled crook hanging down behind the shoulders, the empty right fist tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front hoof steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the crook staff is level, its curled crook pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: staff arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the curled crook of the staff smashing down-right like a club, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty right fist swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the crook staff carries on down until its curled crook nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the brown hair and the holly wreath's leaves trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front hoof pulls back halfway, the crook staff lifts back toward its upright ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty right fist flung out to the left, the staff arm thrown up and out with the crook staff tilting)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, goat legs bent, the crook staff dipping, the empty right fist still held out to the left
flinch.2: recovering: halfway back to the ready pose, the crook staff coming back upright in his left hand

death.1: stagger back: a hoof steps back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, the staff arm flung up holding the crook staff high, the empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, the goat legs fold forward, torso slumps forward, the horned head droops, the crook staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the curled crook of the staff resting on the ground at the lower-right, the empty right arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the crook staff slips out of the left hand, the goat legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, hooves toward the lower-right and horned head toward the upper-left, the holly wreath still on his head; the vine-wrapped crook staff lies on the ground at the lower-right
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the leaf kilt and the leaf sash settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the vine-wrapped crook staff on the ground beside him
